LESSON: MAIN PHYSICAL FEATURES IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and the Built Environments
Topic 1.2: Main physical features in Eastern Africa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Main physical features in Eastern Africa. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can we conserve physical features found in our locality?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa on a map
2. describe the formation of the main physical features of Eastern Africa
3. draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main physical features

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa on a map
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa on a map. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. describe the formation of the main physical features of Eastern Africa
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the formation of the main physical features of Eastern Africa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main physical features
   In simple words: practise until you can draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main physical features. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Main physical features in Eastern Africa using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Main physical features in Eastern Africa in the examples.
2. Explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Main physical features in Eastern Africa.
4. Show that you can: identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa on a map

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Main physical features in Eastern Africa using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Main physical features in Eastern Africa important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Draw a map of Eastern Africa, locate the main physical features, and display in class,
2. Discuss ways of conserving the physical features within the locality to promote environmental education,
3. Digital Literacy: Learners use digital devices to describe the formation of the main physical features in Eastern Africa. Values:
4. Unity: Learners display team spirit as they discuss, in groups, and identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa.
5. Integrity: Learners display discipline as they use digital devices to describe the formation of the main physical features in Eastern Africa. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs):

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we conserve physical features found in our locality?
2. Why are physical features important?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa on a map
2. describe the formation of the main physical features of Eastern Africa
3. draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main physical features

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
